messages:
Maya Chen: Rooftop quiz + wings this Thursday? Thinking 7pm at The Sails (rooftop bar) — wings, veggie skewers, and a couple pitchers. Quick poll: react with :one: for 7pm, :two: for 8pm. I can handle ordering. Who's in?
Omar Ali: I'm in! :thumbsup: Prefer 7pm.
Jen Park: love it. can we please have solid vegetarian/vegan options? happy to bring a small snack platter. :salad:
Devon Singh: Count me in. I have a Bluetooth speaker I can bring and a tiny mic if needed for trivia. Also FYI allergic to peanuts.
Ryan O'Neill: 8pm works better for me because of a call, but I can shuffle stuff to make 7 if that's the majority.
Maya Chen: noted on allergies (thanks Devon). looks like early votes for 7pm so far.
Polly (polls-bot): Poll created — 7pm: 3 votes, 8pm: 1 vote. Vote reactions: :one: :two:.
Jen Park: can someone nab a pitcher of something? i can cover snacks and the trivia questions (5 rounds, ~10 mins each).
Omar Ali: +1 for pitcher. i'll chip in for drinks. :beer: 
Devon Singh: Thanks. Just make sure wing place has clear labels — i'll avoid anything with cross-contam.
Maya Chen: Will confirm menu and vegetarian wings. Final call tomorrow at noon then i'll book table/roof. If 7pm wins i'll post address and nearest Lyft options.
Ryan O'Neill: sounds great. thanks for organizing Maya! :clap:
Jen Park: yesss excited. also thinking a tiny prize (gift card?) for trivia winners — anyone want to contribute?
Omar Ali: I can do $20.
Maya Chen: sweet — i'll aggregate contributions in the thread tomorrow. See you all there!
